# telnyx_agent_gateway_mcp_servers (Data Source)

Lists agent gateway mcp servers, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_agent_gateway_mcp_server`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `agent_gateway_mcp_servers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_mcp_servers))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_mcp_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_mcp_servers`

Read-Only:

- `auth` (Attributes, Sensitive) The server's outbound authentication method. Credentials are never returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_mcp_servers--auth))
- `created_at` (String)
- `forwarded_headers` (Set of String) Headers copied from the agent's request, by name.
- `id` (String) Identifies the server.
- `name` (String) A name for the server, unique on the instance across MCP servers and APIs, regardless of case. Letters, digits, `_`, and `.`. The gateway prefixes the server's tools with it and a hyphen.
- `open_to_every_key` (Boolean) `true` lets every key on the instance use the server, granted or not.
- `static_headers` (String, Sensitive) Headers sent on every request. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `tools` (Set of String) The tools the server exposes to every key, by name. `[]` exposes every tool.
- `transport` (String) `http` for Streamable HTTP, or `sse` for Server-Sent Events.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String) The server's MCP endpoint.

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_mcp_servers--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_mcp_servers.auth`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The method's `type`.
